title: Căn Nhà Âm Dương: Oan Hồn Dưới Gốc Mít
style: Photorealistic live-action Vietnamese folk-horror drama set in the Northern Vietnamese countryside; natural skin texture, damp air, realistic practical light (tungsten, oil lamps, moonlight), subtle 35mm film grain.

narrator.voice: Vietnamese man about 45, standard Hà Nội accent with clear six tones, firm resonant baritone with a slight rasp, crisp consonants, tense late-night ghost-story delivery at a brisk, steady pace, only tiny breaths at commas, no dragged vowels

@Binh.name: Bình
@Binh.anchor: Bình, 21, thin pale Vietnamese university student; messy short black hair, dark circles under tired eyes; dark charcoal-grey hoodie over a white T-shirt, dark jeans, worn sneakers, black backpack.
@Binh.voice: young man of 21, standard Hà Nội accent, light tenor, shaky and breathless with fear

@BaPhuong.name: Bà Phượng
@BaPhuong.anchor: Bà Phượng, Bình's mother, 50; gentle worried oval face, black hair with grey streaks in a low bun; plain blue blouse, dark trousers.
@BaPhuong.voice: woman of 50, standard Hà Nội accent, warm mezzo voice, tearful and worried

@OngQuan.name: Ông Quân
@OngQuan.anchor: Ông Quân, Bình's father, 55; stocky, crew-cut greying hair, stern face with deep frown lines; white collared shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers.
@OngQuan.voice: man of 55, standard Hà Nội accent, deep stern gravelly baritone

@OngBay.name: Ông Bảy
@OngBay.anchor: Ông Bảy, 60, the neighbouring village farmer; lean and sun-tanned, silver-streaked hair, kind wrinkled face; faded plaid shirt, brown work trousers, rubber sandals; often with his old black bicycle.
@OngBay.voice: village man of 60, Northern accent, warm rustic baritone

@VongCuXa.name: vong hồn cụ Xá
@VongCuXa.anchor: the ghost of Cụ Xá, Bình's late grandfather, about 80; gaunt, wispy white hair and beard, sad hollow eyes; faded brown traditional áo bà ba, barefoot; semi-transparent with a faint cold glow.
@VongCuXa.voice: very old man, Northern accent, soft hoarse voice with a faint echo, gentle and unhurried

@VongLa.name: vong lạ dưới gốc mít
@VongLa.anchor: the wandering ghost of the jackfruit tree: tall gaunt figure, ash-grey damp skin, tangled wet black hair over half the face, long thin fingers, tattered dark wet clothes.
@VongLa.voice: cold breathy whisper, Northern accent, echoing as if from every direction

scenes.title: Chuyến Xe Khách Đêm Khuya & Món Nợ Bốn Trăm Triệu
scenes.time_label: 23:30 Đêm khuya trên quốc lộ về quê nội (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Lone sleeper coach bus crawling along a misty Northern Vietnamese rural highway and the dimly lit window seat inside the bus cabin (plus brief phone cutaway to @BaPhuong's kitchen).
scenes.axis: Inside the dimly lit sleeper bus cabin by the rain-streaked glass window where @Binh clutches his black backpack as amber highway lights sweep past.
scenes.props: Sleeper coach bus window streaked with rain, worn plush passenger seat, black backpack, glowing smartphone screen showing a liquidated trading account.
scenes.setting: Night, heavy rain. Inside a dim sleeper coach crawling along a misty Northern Vietnamese rural highway; amber highway lights sweep across the rain-streaked window seat.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ôm món nợ hơn bốn trăm triệu đồng không lối thoát, Bình đành bỏ trốn trong đêm về căn nhà hoang của ông nội.
clips.camera: 24mm stabilized aerial drone slow descending push-in
beats: Wide aerial view above dark misty Northern Vietnamese rice fields as a lone coach bus rolls along the highway.

High-angle aerial camera gliding over dark, fog-shrouded Northern Vietnamese rice paddies at midnight and descending toward the rain-streaked window of a lone sleeper coach bus where @Binh sits huddled.
Camera pushes in close to the rain-streaked sleeper bus window revealing @Binh huddled inside.
clips.sfx: coach engine droning low through the night rain, wind whistling across the open fields
clips.setting: Night, heavy rain: dark fog-shrouded rice paddies and a lonely rural highway; a sleeper coach crawls along it, its rain-streaked windows dimly lit.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhưng Bình đâu hề biết sau vụ tai nạn cướp đi sáu mạng người, căn nhà ấy đã thành nơi trú ngụ của ma quỷ.
beats: Interior view by the rain-streaked bus window where @Binh hugs his black backpack.
Inside the dimly lit sleeper bus cabin, @Binh clutches his black backpack tightly against his chest as passing amber highway streetlights sweep across his pale, hollow-eyed face.
@Binh stares blankly at his pale reflection in the wet glass as his jacket pocket begins to vibrate.
clips.sfx: steady swish of the coach's wipers, heavy uneasy breathing

clips.speaker: @Binh
clips.line: Con nghe đây mẹ ơi, con đang ngồi trên xe khách về quê nội rồi, mẹ đừng gọi nhiều nhỡ người ta nghe thấy.
beats: @Binh pulls his buzzing smartphone from his hoodie pocket by the dark bus window.
@Binh flinches, answers the call and speaks in a low, frightened voice, the phone at his ear and his face turned toward the camera so his lips stay clearly visible.
@Binh keeps the phone pressed to his ear, eyes darting nervously toward the dark aisle.
clips.sfx: phone buzzing against the seat cushion, low rumble of the coach in the dark cabin

clips.speaker: @BaPhuong
clips.line: Bố mày vẫn chưa biết chuyện đâu, nhưng đám chủ nợ sắp tìm tới nhà rồi, mày về quê nội phải thật cẩn thận nhé!
beats: Medium close-up of @BaPhuong standing at a worn wooden kitchen table under a weak yellow bulb, phone pressed to her ear.
@BaPhuong grips the edge of the table, tears brimming, and warns her son in an urgent voice, her face toward the camera.
Tears roll down @BaPhuong's cheeks as she clutches the table edge, the phone still at her ear.
clips.sfx: an old electric fan rattling as it turns, the mother's choked breathing
clips.setting: Night. A small, dim city apartment kitchen: worn wooden table, weak yellow bulb, old electric fan.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tất cả bi kịch bắt nguồn từ cái bẫy tiền ảo trên mạng, chỉ sau một đêm mất trắng mà nợ lãi chồng chất.
beats: Back inside the dark bus cabin as @Binh lowers his glowing smartphone screen.
Back in his dark sleeper bus seat, @Binh lowers the smartphone and stares at a screenshot of his liquidated online trading account glowing red, burying his face in his shaking hands.
@Binh buries his forehead in both trembling hands beside the rain-streaked window.
clips.sfx: flat beep of the call ending, bitter remorseful breathing

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Không còn mặt mũi nào nhìn bố, Bình đánh liều trốn về quê mà chẳng ngờ mình đang tự bước chân vào cõi âm.
beats: @Binh locks his phone screen and rests his forehead against the cold bus window.
@Binh switches off his phone screen and leans his forehead against the freezing wet bus glass, watching his hollow reflection as the coach plunges deeper into rural night fog.
The sleeper coach bus disappears into dense white rural highway fog in the night.
clips.sfx: coach tyres hissing through rain puddles, hollow night wind

scenes.title: Bến Xe Thị Xã, Quán Cơm Bụi & Cánh Cổng Sắt Dưới Gốc Mít Cổ Thụ
scenes.time_label: 14:30–17:45 Chiều tà nơi thị xã và đường về xóm nhỏ (01:00–02:00)
scenes.location: Dusty provincial bus drop-off, roadside rice stall, narrow concrete village lane flanked by bamboo groves, and the rusted black iron gate under the ancient jackfruit tree.
scenes.axis: Progression from the town roadside and bamboo-lined concrete village path straight to the rusted iron gate and gnarled ancient jackfruit tree of Cụ Xá's abandoned house.
scenes.props: Black backpack, low plastic table and cold rice plate at the roadside stall, smartphone SMS, narrow concrete path between rice paddies, iron hoe, rusted black iron gate, gnarled ancient jackfruit tree.
scenes.setting: Afternoon in a small Northern Vietnamese provincial town and its village: a dusty bus stop, a roadside rice stall, a narrow concrete lane between rice paddies and old bamboo groves.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hơn hai giờ chiều chiếc xe khách thả Bình xuống bến thị xã nhỏ, giữa nơi đất khách cậu mới dám thở phào.
beats: @Binh steps off the coach bus onto the dusty provincial roadside wearing his black backpack.
Under pale late-afternoon sun at a dusty provincial bus stop, the coach pulls away and @Binh steps onto the gravel shoulder with his black backpack, letting out a long, exhausted breath.
@Binh adjusts his backpack straps and looks toward a humble roadside rice stall.
clips.sfx: coach horn fading away down the highway, afternoon wind blowing grit underfoot

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngồi bên quán cơm bụi nhìn tin nhắn mẹ chuyển năm trăm nghìn cuối cùng, sống mũi Bình bỗng nhiên cay xè.
beats: @Binh sits hunched at a low plastic table looking down at his smartphone beside a rice plate.
@Binh sits alone at a low plastic table in a roadside eatery, staring down at a text message showing his mother just transferred her last five hundred thousand dong beside a plate of cold rice.
@Binh swallows hard with reddened eyes, unable to touch the cold rice before him.
clips.sfx: a soft message chime on the phone, a spoon clinking on a china plate

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cậu tự nhủ sẽ ẩn náu ở quê nội ít ngày, nhưng khi hỏi thăm đường về nhà cụ Xá thì ai cũng biến sắc.
beats: @Binh puts his phone away and stands up from the roadside plastic table.
@Binh slips the phone into his hoodie pocket, stares briefly at his trembling thin hands, then rises with his backpack to walk down the narrow concrete road leading into his grandfather's village.
@Binh walks onto the narrow concrete village road bordered by quiet fields.
clips.sfx: a plastic stool scraping on concrete, lone footsteps

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Con đường bê tông dẫn về thôn cứ hẹp dần giữa cánh đồng chiều vắng lặng, rợp bóng tre già âm u lạnh lẽo.
beats: @Binh walks down the narrow concrete path beneath overhanging dark bamboo stalks.
@Binh walks alone along the narrow concrete lane between two darkening afternoon rice paddies as cold wind bends the overarching old bamboo groves with a hollow, eerie creak.
@Binh slows his pace as he spots an elderly farmer ahead near the village entrance.
clips.sfx: old bamboo stalks creaking against each other in the cold evening wind

clips.speaker: @OngBay
clips.line: Căn nhà cuối xóm có gốc mít cổ thụ ấy bỏ hoang hai mươi năm nay rồi cậu ơi, nhà ấy nặng âm khí có ma đấy!
beats: @Binh stops on the concrete lane as @OngBay walks toward him, pushing an old black bicycle.
@OngBay stops beside @Binh, looks him over warily, then speaks and points down the lane toward a towering jackfruit tree at the far edge of the village, his face toward the camera.
@OngBay points his calloused hand down the lane toward the dark canopy at the village edge.
clips.sfx: wind rustling the rice paddies, a bicycle chain ticking

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đứng trước cánh cổng sắt rỉ sét và gốc mít cổ thụ vặn vẹo, một luồng khí lạnh thổi ra làm Bình rùng mình.
beats: @Binh approaches the rusted black iron gate beneath the massive ancient jackfruit tree.
Following the pointed path, @Binh halts before a peeling, rusted black iron gate; inside the weed-choked yard, a gnarled ancient jackfruit tree looms over the dark three-bay tiled house.
@Binh grips the cold rusted iron bars looking into the overgrown, shadowed courtyard.
clips.sfx: dry jackfruit leaves rustling at dusk, rusted gate hinges groaning softly
clips.setting: Dusk: the rusted black iron gate under an ancient twisted jackfruit tree at the end of the village lane; an overgrown yard and a dark three-bay tiled house behind it.

scenes.title: Ông Bảy Hàng Xóm & Lời Kể Rợn Tóc Gáy Về Vụ Lật Xe Lúc Ba Giờ Sáng
scenes.time_label: 18:00–21:00 Chập tối tại cổng nhà hoang và hiên nhà Ông Bảy (02:00–03:00)
scenes.location: Rusted iron gate under the ancient jackfruit tree, the village lane, and @OngBay's warm-lit porch looking out toward the dark highway curve before Cụ Xá's gate.
scenes.axis: Axis from the rusted iron gate of the abandoned house to @OngBay's neighbor porch overlooking the misty highway curve and jackfruit tree.
scenes.props: Vintage Phượng Hoàng bicycle, rusted iron gate bars, hot green tea cups on a wooden table, misty highway curve outside the gate, gnarled jackfruit tree roots.
scenes.setting: Dusk: the rusted iron gate under the ancient jackfruit tree and the quiet village lane.

clips.speaker: @OngBay
clips.line: Ơ cậu hỏi đường lúc chiều đây mà, trời tối rồi sao còn đứng lấp ló trước cổng nhà ấy thế hả?!
beats: @Binh holds the rusted iron gate bars as @OngBay brakes his old black bicycle right behind him.
@OngBay recognizes the young man from the afternoon and calls out to him with suspicion from his bicycle, his face toward the camera, while @Binh still grips the gate bars.
@Binh turns around, startled, to face @OngBay's stern gaze.
clips.sfx: bicycle brakes squealing on concrete, crickets starting up

clips.speaker: @Binh
clips.line: Dạ cháu không phải kẻ gian đâu bác ơi, cháu là Bình cháu nội cụ Xá, con trai bố Quân trên phố về thăm nhà ạ!
beats: @Binh steps back from the gate and bows his head respectfully toward @OngBay.
@Binh explains who he is, his face toward the camera; hearing the name of his late neighbour's grandson, @OngBay's stern face softens.
@OngBay smiles warmly and pats @Binh's shoulder.
clips.sfx: a relieved exhale, a warm pat on the hoodie shoulder

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhận ra đứa cháu nội của ông cụ hàng xóm quá cố, ông Bảy mừng rỡ dẫn Bình về nhà mình nghỉ tạm qua đêm.
beats: @OngBay wheels his bicycle alongside @Binh away from the dark jackfruit gate.
@OngBay walks his bicycle side by side with @Binh away from the rusted iron gate toward his own modest three-bay tiled house at the head of the lane as dusk settles.
Both walk toward the warm yellow porch light of @OngBay's house down the lane.
clips.sfx: bicycle freewheel ticking steadily, evening insects chirring

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Thế nhưng vừa nghe chồng bảo ngày mai cho Bình sang nhà hoang ở, vợ ông Bảy đã tái mặt kéo chồng ra góc hiên.
beats: @Binh sits drinking hot tea at a wooden table on @OngBay's warm-lit porch.
While @Binh sips his tea, @OngBay's wife beckons her husband to the corner pillar and whispers urgently; @OngBay listens with a troubled frown.
@OngBay's expression darkens with worry as he glances out toward the dark village road.
clips.sfx: a china cup set down on a wooden tray, an anxious wordless whisper from the porch corner
clips.extras: @OngBay's wife: a thin village woman about 58 in a faded floral blouse, hair in a bun (unnamed, no reference image).
clips.setting: Night: Ông Bảy's warm-lit tiled porch with a wooden tea table, looking out through fog toward the dark road bend and the black jackfruit tree by Cụ Xá's gate.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bà nhắc rằng mười ba năm trước đúng ba giờ sáng, chiếc xe rước dâu lật nhào trước cổng làm sáu người chết thảm.
beats: Over @OngBay's shoulder looking out from the porch into the fog-shrouded highway curve.
From his porch, @OngBay stares out through the thickening night fog toward the sharp highway curve right in front of Cụ Xá's rusted gate and the looming black jackfruit tree.
In the distance, the dark silhouette of the ancient jackfruit tree looms over the empty curve.
clips.sfx: cold night wind hissing through bamboo, a faint distant echo like tyres screeching
clips.setting: Night: Ông Bảy's warm-lit tiled porch with a wooden tea table, looking out through fog toward the dark road bend and the black jackfruit tree by Cụ Xá's gate.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Những oan hồn chết oan khuất không tìm được đường về đã kéo cả vào căn nhà bỏ không ấy trú ngụ suốt bao năm.
beats: Creeping view through white night mist toward the gnarled roots of the ancient jackfruit tree.

The camera pushes slowly through the ground fog beneath the gnarled ancient jackfruit tree outside the rusted iron gate, where the tall, skeletal silhouette of @VongLa stands staring into the abandoned house.
@VongLa's tall, ash-grey figure stands half-hidden behind the weeds staring through the iron gate.
clips.sfx: jackfruit leaves falling on wet grass, a deep hollow sigh from the old tree
clips.setting: Night, ground fog: the gnarled roots of the ancient jackfruit tree outside Cụ Xá's rusted gate.

scenes.title: Phá Khóa Dọn Nhà Hoang & Cuộc Gọi Tuyệt Vọng Từ Mẹ
scenes.time_label: 07:00–11:30 Sáng hôm sau tại căn nhà hoang của Cụ Xá (03:00–04:00)
scenes.location: Overgrown brick courtyard under the jackfruit tree, rusted iron gate, and the dusty, empty three-bay tiled house interior without an ancestral altar.
scenes.axis: Axis from the broken padlock at the iron gate across the leaf-strewn brick courtyard into the bare, peeling-plaster main room.
scenes.props: Bamboo broom, iron hoe breaking the rusted padlock, rotting jackfruit leaves and weeds in the courtyard, cobwebs, empty peeling-plaster main room, ringing smartphone.
scenes.setting: Bright morning: the overgrown mossy brick courtyard under the ancient jackfruit tree and the rusted iron gate.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ánh nắng ban mai trong trẻo xua tan màn sương đêm, làm những lời đồn thổi ma quỷ tối hôm qua tạm thời lắng xuống.
beats: @Binh walks along the sunlit morning lane carrying a bamboo broom toward the iron gate.
Morning sunlight burns away the night mist under the jackfruit tree as @Binh walks up to the rusted iron gate carrying a bamboo broom while roosters crow across the village.
@Binh stops before the rusted padlock on the black iron gate under the jackfruit tree.
clips.sfx: roosters crowing across the village, sparrows chirping

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm ấy ông Bảy dùng cán cuốc bẩy gãy tung chiếc ổ khóa sắt rỉ, mở toang cánh cổng khóa suốt hai mươi năm.
beats: @OngBay inserts his hoe handle into the rusted padlock while @Binh holds the gate bar.
At the iron gate, @OngBay wedges the wooden handle of his iron hoe into the rusted padlock beside @Binh and wrenches downward, snapping the 20-year-old lock open with a sharp metallic crack.
The broken padlock drops onto the mossy bricks and the iron gate swings open.
clips.sfx: the rusted padlock snapping with a sharp crack, the heavy iron gate creaking open

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Suốt ba tiếng đồng hồ phát cỏ dại và quét mạng nhện, khoảng sân gạch rêu phong dưới gốc mít cổ thụ mới lộ ra.
beats: @Binh sweeps piles of dry jackfruit leaves across the mossy brick courtyard.
Inside the open gate, @Binh sweeps away thick layers of rotting brown jackfruit leaves, weeds, and cobwebs across the mossy brick courtyard beneath the sprawling tree canopy.
@Binh wipes sweat from his forehead and looks toward the dark open doorway of the main house.
clips.sfx: a bamboo broom sweeping dry leaves across old bricks

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bước qua ngưỡng cửa vào gian nhà chính trống huơ không một nén hương sưởi ấm, lòng Bình chợt chùng xuống lạnh lẽo.
beats: @Binh steps over the wooden threshold into the dusty, empty three-bay main room.
@Binh steps across the wooden threshold into the bare, peeling-plaster main room; slanted afternoon sunbeams cut through roof tile gaps illuminating thick dust motes where no ancestral altar stands.
@Binh stands alone in the center of the bare room looking at the empty altar wall.
clips.sfx: footsteps echoing in the empty room, wind through gaps in the old roof tiles
clips.setting: Late morning: the dusty, empty three-bay main room with peeling plaster and no ancestral altar; sunbeams through gaps in the roof tiles.

clips.speaker: @BaPhuong
clips.line: Bình ơi! Bố mày đã biết hết chuyện nợ nần rồi con ơi, ông ấy đang điên tiết lùng tìm mày khắp nơi đấy!
beats: Tight close-up of @BaPhuong in a dim city room pressing her phone to her tear-stained cheek.
A shrill ringtone shatters the silence; on the other end in the city, @BaPhuong cowers in a dark room corner clutching her phone with both hands, sobbing in sheer panic.
@BaPhuong's voice cuts off abruptly as she lowers the phone in terror.
clips.sfx: panicked breathing, a faint crash of things breaking in another room

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cuộc gọi tắt phụt cắt đứt tia hy vọng cuối cùng, Bình ngồi gục xuống nền gạch lạnh ngắt giữa căn nhà ma.
beats: @Binh stands frozen in the bare main room as the phone call disconnects.
Hearing the line go dead, @Binh lowers his phone with a lifeless arm, slides his back down the peeling damp lime wall onto the cold brick floor, and buries his head in his knees.
@Binh slumps onto the cold brick floor against the peeling wall holding his head.
clips.sfx: a phone knocking on the brick floor, a despairing sigh in the empty house
clips.setting: Late morning: the dusty, empty three-bay main room with peeling plaster and no ancestral altar; sunbeams through gaps in the roof tiles.

scenes.title: Đêm Đầu Tiên Một Mình & Vết Bầm Năm Ngón Tay Lúc Rạng Sáng
scenes.time_label: 23:45 Đêm đầu tiên đến 06:00 Sáng hôm sau (04:00–05:00)
scenes.location: Dimly lit main room of the abandoned house with a creaking folding cot inside a thin white mosquito net under a 15W yellow filament bulb, opening onto the sunlit morning porch.
scenes.axis: Interior bedroom axis centered on the folding cot and thin white mosquito net against the peeling lime wall, aligned with the wooden door out to the sunny porch.
scenes.props: Creaking metal folding cot, thin white mosquito net (màn tuyn trắng), dim 15W yellow filament bulb, dark five-finger bruise on @Binh's left wrist.
scenes.setting: First night: the dim main room of the abandoned house, a creaking folding cot inside a thin white mosquito net under a weak yellow filament bulb.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm đầu tiên ngủ lại một mình dưới ánh đèn dây tóc vàng vọt, Bình kéo chăn ngang ngực cố tự trấn an mình.
beats: @Binh lies curled on the folding cot inside the thin white mosquito net under dim yellow light.
On his first night alone under the dim, sickly yellow glow of a 15W filament bulb, @Binh lies curled on a creaking folding cot inside a thin white mosquito net, pulling his blanket tight.
@Binh closes his tired eyes beneath the mosquito net as the room shadows deepen.
clips.sfx: frogs croaking in the night paddies, the folding cot creaking softly

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khi cơn mê man vừa kéo đến, ngay sát bên ngoài lớp màn mỏng bỗng có bóng người cao gầy lặng lẽ đi quanh giường!
beats: High angle descending toward the white mosquito net in the dimly lit room.
The camera lowers slowly from the dark ceiling beams toward the white mosquito net where @Binh dozes; the shadows thicken, and the tall gaunt figure of @VongLa circles silently right outside the net.
@VongLa's tall dark silhouette pauses right beside the thin mosquito net above @Binh.
clips.sfx: wet bare footsteps gliding on the brick floor, the mosquito net trembling

clips.speaker: @Binh
clips.line: Ai đó?! Bỏ ngay cái bàn tay lạnh buốt ấy ra khỏi người tôi, cứu tôi với, có ai ngoài đó bỏ tôi ra!!
beats: Close framing inside the mosquito net: @Binh lies rigid as a long ash-grey hand hovers just above his left wrist.
Frost creeps across @Binh's skin under @VongLa's hovering grey hand; his eyes fly open, his body frozen in sleep paralysis, and he cries out in terror, his face toward the camera.
@Binh strains his neck, gasping, unable to move, as the grey hand slowly withdraws into the dark.
clips.sfx: the folding cot rattling, an icy hiss of frost, faint ghostly breathing

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Giật mình choàng tỉnh khi trời vừa hửng sáng, Bình chết lặng nhìn vết bầm tím đen năm ngón tay hằn sâu trên cổ tay!
beats: Morning sunlight hits the mosquito net as @Binh bolts upright on the folding cot.

Morning sunbeams slant through the wooden window bars across the folding cot; @Binh bolts upright drenched in cold sweat and freezes as he looks down at a dark purple five-finger bruise on his left wrist.
@Binh stares in horror at the dark five-finger bruise encircling his pale left wrist.
clips.sfx: ragged waking gasps, early-morning birds outside

scenes.title: Cuộc Gọi Cho Bố & Bàn Tay Giận Dữ Khựng Lại Giữa Sân Quê
scenes.time_label: 06:00 Rạng sáng đến 16:30 Chiều Ngày thứ sáu (10:00–11:00)
scenes.location: Mossy stone porch steps and brick courtyard of the ancestral rural house (with phone cutaway to @OngQuan in the city).
scenes.axis: Axis from the stone porch steps across the brick courtyard to the rusted iron gate under the jackfruit tree where @OngQuan and @BaPhuong arrive.
scenes.props: Smartphone, rusted iron gate opening in afternoon sun, mossy brick courtyard tiles.
scenes.setting: Morning: the mossy stone porch steps and brick courtyard of the ancestral house.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trắng đêm suy nghĩ sau cuộc gặp gỡ đẫm nước mắt với ông nội, vừa rạng sáng Bình đã lấy hết can đảm bấm gọi cho bố.
beats: @Binh sits on the stone porch steps at dawn holding his smartphone.
At dawn after his tearful encounter with his grandfather's spirit, @Binh steps out onto the pale sunlit porch steps, takes a deep steadying breath, and dials his father's phone number.
@Binh raises the phone to his ear with a calm, determined expression.
clips.sfx: early birds singing in the garden, phone keypad taps
clips.setting: Dawn, pale early light: the mossy stone porch steps of the ancestral house.

clips.speaker: @OngQuan
clips.line: Thằng nghịch tử kia! Mày phá gia chi tử nợ bốn trăm triệu rồi còn dám lôi vong hồn ông nội ra lừa bố hả?!
beats: Medium close-up of @OngQuan by a city window gripping his phone in blazing anger.
In a bright city room by a window, @OngQuan stands flushed with fury, clenching his fist as he roars into the smartphone pressed against his ear.
@OngQuan glares out the window breathing heavily as he listens to his son's reply.
clips.sfx: city apartment room tone, distant traffic
clips.setting: Early morning. A bright city apartment room by a window.

clips.speaker: @Binh
clips.line: Bố về đánh gãy chân con cũng được, nhưng con van xin bố hãy về quê thắp hương xin lỗi ông nội một lần đi bố ơi!
beats: @Binh kneels upright on the stone porch steps clutching the phone to his ear.
Out on the rural porch steps, @Binh drops straight to his knees on the brick tiles with tears rolling down his cheeks, speaking into the phone with unwavering sincerity.
Tears stream down @Binh's face as the phone line clicks dead.
clips.sfx: knees on the porch bricks, morning birds

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tiếng điện thoại cúp máy cái rập, Bình vẫn ngồi bất động nơi bậc thềm hiên nhà, sẵn sàng chịu đòn chờ người cha trở về.
beats: @Binh lowers the disconnected smartphone into his lap on the porch steps.

The phone line disconnects abruptly; @Binh lowers the handset into his lap and remains seated quietly on the mossy stone porch steps, keeping his eyes fixed on the rusted iron gate under the jackfruit tree.
@Binh sits motionless on the porch looking straight out toward the rusted iron gate.
clips.sfx: afternoon wind rustling jackfruit leaves across the quiet courtyard

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Quả nhiên ngay chiều hôm ấy ông Quân cùng bà Phượng đã về tới cổng, đôi mắt người cha long lên giận dữ khi thấy con trai.
beats: @OngQuan pushes open the rusted iron gate and strides into the courtyard with @BaPhuong behind him.
As late afternoon sun slants through the jackfruit tree, the iron gate swings wide open: @OngQuan strides furiously across the brick courtyard toward @Binh, followed closely by an anxious @BaPhuong.
@OngQuan marches straight up to @Binh standing before the porch steps.
clips.sfx: the iron gate thrown open with a clang, hurried footsteps on the bricks
clips.setting: Late afternoon, low golden sun: the brick courtyard, the porch steps and the rusted iron gate under the jackfruit tree.

clips.speaker: @Binh
clips.line: Con xin chịu hết mọi hình phạt của bố mẹ, nhưng con cầu xin bố tối nay hãy ngủ lại căn nhà này một đêm thôi!
beats: @OngQuan stands over @Binh in the courtyard with his right hand raised high in fury as @BaPhuong rushes in.
@OngQuan's raised hand trembles in the air and stops; @BaPhuong steps between father and son, weeping; @Binh kneels on the bricks and pleads up at his father, his face toward the camera.
@Binh bows his forehead to the bricks before @OngQuan, who slowly lowers his hand, jaw clenched.
clips.sfx: the father's heavy furious breathing, the mother's sobs, wind in the jackfruit leaves
clips.setting: Late afternoon, low golden sun: the brick courtyard, the porch steps and the rusted iron gate under the jackfruit tree.

scenes.title: Giấc Mơ Đẫm Nước Mắt Của Ông Quân & Nén Hương Tạ Tội Trước Mộ Cha
scenes.time_label: 23:00 Đêm thứ sáu đến Sáng hôm sau (11:00–12:00)
scenes.location: Main room wooden bed at night, misty village rice-field cemetery at dawn, newly installed mahogany altar in the main room, and brick shrine under the jackfruit tree.
scenes.axis: Progression from the moonlit main hall bed to Cụ Xá's mossy stone grave in the field, then back to the central mahogany altar and gate jackfruit shrine.
scenes.props: Wooden bed in main room, mossy stone grave in misty rice field, burning incense sticks, newly carved mahogany ancestral altar (tủ thờ gỗ gụ), bronze incense burner and portrait of Cụ Xá, small brick shrine under the jackfruit tree.
scenes.setting: Night: the dark main room of the ancestral house with a wooden bed in the centre and a small side table; moonlight through wooden shutters.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm hôm ấy ông Quân nhất quyết nằm ngay tại gian phòng khách cũ, tuyên bố đanh thép sáng mai sẽ áp giải con về phố.
beats: @OngQuan lies on the wooden bed in the dim main room while @BaPhuong and @Binh sit nearby.
Night falls over the ancestral house: @OngQuan lies stern-faced on a wooden bed placed in the center of the dark main room, while @BaPhuong and @Binh sit quietly awake at a side table.
@OngQuan closes his stern eyes as cold moonlight filters through the wooden shutters.
clips.sfx: night insects in the garden, heavy breathing in the dark house

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Giữa đêm khuya không ai biết ông Quân mơ thấy điều gì, chỉ thấy người đàn ông sắt đá ấy bật khóc trong giấc ngủ.
beats: Close framing on @OngQuan's sleeping face as @VongCuXa's translucent form stands by the headboard.
Under cold silver moonlight, the camera pushes close to @OngQuan's sleeping face: his brows knit in deep anguish and hot tears stream from his closed eyes as @VongCuXa stands silently beside the bed.
Tears roll down @OngQuan's weathered cheeks in the moonlight as @VongCuXa gazes down at him.
clips.sfx: the father's muffled sobs in his sleep, soft night wind

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khi trời vừa tờ mờ sáng, ông Quân lặng lẽ mua hương hoa ra nghĩa trang đồng làng, một mình quỳ gục hàng giờ trước mộ cha.
clips.camera: 35mm stabilized slow push-in in morning mist
beats: @OngQuan kneels alone in the misty field cemetery before his father's mossy stone grave.
At dawn in the white mist of the village rice-field cemetery, a red-eyed @OngQuan kneels alone in the wet grass before Cụ Xá's mossy stone grave, bowing deeply as he plants burning incense.
@OngQuan plants burning incense sticks into the censer and bows his forehead to the damp earth.
clips.sfx: dawn wind over the fields carrying incense smoke, remorseful sobs
clips.setting: Dawn: white mist over a village rice-field cemetery; Cụ Xá's mossy stone grave in the wet grass.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trở về từ nghĩa trang, ông Quân lập tức cùng Bình tự tay khiêng chiếc tủ thờ gỗ gụ mới tinh đặt vào chính giữa gian nhà.
beats: @OngQuan and @Binh carry a carved mahogany altar cabinet through the doorway into the main hall.
Returning to the ancestral house, @OngQuan rolls up his shirt sleeves and works side by side with @Binh to carry a newly carved mahogany ancestral altar cabinet into the center of the main room.
Father and son set the mahogany altar cabinet squarely against the central wall.
clips.sfx: mahogany cabinet legs set down firmly on the brick floor
clips.setting: Daytime: the main room of the ancestral house as a new carved mahogany altar cabinet is carried in.

clips.speaker: @OngQuan
clips.line: Bố ơi con bất hiếu quá, bao năm để hồn bố lạnh lẽo nơi quê nhà, hôm nay con xin rước bố về gian thờ tổ!
beats: @OngQuan places the bronze incense burner on the mahogany altar and lights three incense sticks.
@OngQuan sets Cụ Xá's portrait on the new altar and kneels before it, @BaPhuong and @Binh kneeling behind him; he turns his tear-streaked face slightly toward the camera as he prays aloud.
@OngQuan kneels with clasped hands before the glowing altar, @BaPhuong and @Binh behind him.
clips.sfx: a match striking, incense catching
clips.setting: Daytime: the main room with the new mahogany altar, Cụ Xá's framed portrait, a bronze incense burner and sandalwood incense.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngay dưới gốc mít cổ thụ trước cổng, ông Quân còn cho dựng một ngôi miếu gạch nhỏ và lập đàn cầu siêu cho sáu vong hồn.
beats: @OngQuan and @Binh stand before the newly built brick shrine beneath the ancient jackfruit tree.
Out beneath the ancient jackfruit tree by the front gate, @OngQuan and @Binh finish building a small, solemn brick shrine where fragrant incense smoke curls upward to soothe the wandering spirits.
Fragrant incense smoke rises from the small brick shrine up into the green jackfruit leaves.
clips.sfx: a temple bell ringing warmly, incense smoke drifting under the jackfruit tree
clips.setting: Daytime: under the ancient jackfruit tree by the front gate, a small newly built brick shrine.

scenes.title: Bốn Mươi Chín Ngày Ăn Chay Cầu Siêu & Ngôi Miếu Nhỏ Dưới Gốc Mít
scenes.time_label: Suốt 49 ngày hương khói tại quê nội (12:00–13:00)
scenes.location: Warm, incense-filled three-bay ancestral house, sunlit brick courtyard, small brick shrine beneath the jackfruit tree, and refurbished stone grave in the green rice field.
scenes.axis: Axis connecting the warm glowing mahogany altar inside the main hall across the swept courtyard to the peaceful shrine beneath the jackfruit tree.
scenes.props: Mahogany altar glowing with oil lamps and sandalwood incense, bamboo broom, fresh fruit offering plate and burning incense at the jackfruit brick shrine, refurbished stone grave.
scenes.setting: During the forty-nine days of mourning: the warm, incense-filled main hall with the new mahogany altar and the sunlit brick courtyard.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Suốt bốn mươi chín ngày ròng rã, ông Quân xin nghỉ ở lại quê ăn chay hương khói, sưởi ấm ngôi nhà lạnh lẽo hai thập kỷ.
beats: @OngQuan bows with glowing incense at the mahogany altar while sunlight fills the open doorway.
In the peaceful morning light, @OngQuan in a simple white shirt lights fresh incense at the mahogany altar inside, while out on the sunny porch @BaPhuong and @Binh sweep the clean courtyard.
Camera pans toward the sunny courtyard where @BaPhuong and @Binh sweep fallen leaves together.
clips.sfx: a broom sweeping softly in the morning sun

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngôi miếu nhỏ dưới gốc mít luôn đỏ đèn nhang mỗi tối, để những vong hồn lỡ bước trên khúc cua năm nào có chốn nương tựa.
beats: @OngQuan walks out to the small brick shrine beneath the sunlit jackfruit tree with fresh fruit.
In the golden afternoon sunlight beneath the ancient jackfruit tree, @OngQuan reverently places a plate of fresh fruit and lights incense at the small brick shrine, the air now peaceful and warm.
@OngQuan clasps his hands respectfully as three incense sticks glow warmly in the shrine.
clips.sfx: green jackfruit leaves rustling in the afternoon sun
clips.setting: Golden afternoon: the small brick shrine under the ancient jackfruit tree by the gate.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đêm thứ bốn mươi chín, cả căn nhà ngói ba gian tỏa ra luồng sinh khí ấm áp lạ thường, không còn bóng đen lạnh lẽo nữa.
beats: @OngQuan and @Binh kneel side by side on a woven mat before the warm-lit mahogany altar.
On the forty-ninth night inside the main worship hall, @OngQuan and @Binh sit side by side with clasped hands before Cụ Xá's warm oil-lamp altar as fragrant incense smoke curls peacefully upward.
Warm amber lantern light bathes their calm faces as incense smoke rises toward the rafters.
clips.sfx: the oil lamp burning softly on the altar, calm breathing
clips.setting: The forty-ninth night: the main worship hall glowing with warm oil-lamp light before the mahogany altar.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhìn từ ngoài cổng vào trong đêm, lần đầu tiên sau hai mươi năm dân làng thấy căn nhà cụ Xá sáng bừng ánh đèn ấm áp.
clips.camera: 28mm stabilized dolly slow pull-back through gate
beats: View from the courtyard looking into the warm golden-lit doorway where @OngQuan and @Binh sit.
Seen from outside the jackfruit tree looking across the brick courtyard at night, warm golden light glows through all the wooden windows of the three-bay house where @OngQuan and @Binh talk.
Camera pulls back past the jackfruit shrine, framing the glowing three-bay house in the night.
clips.sfx: a village temple bell ringing far away in the peaceful night
clips.setting: Night: the view from the jackfruit tree across the brick courtyard to the glowing three-bay house.

clips.speaker: @OngQuan
clips.line: Bà đưa thằng Bình về phố lo trả dần nợ nần trước đi, tôi ở lại sửa sang lại mộ phần cho ông cụ.
beats: On the sunlit wooden porch, @OngQuan places a steady hand on @Binh's shoulder beside @BaPhuong.
The next morning on the sunlit porch, @OngQuan rests a forgiving hand on @Binh's shoulder and turns to @BaPhuong with a calm, compassionate expression.
@Binh and @BaPhuong nod gratefully as @OngQuan looks warmly at his son.
clips.sfx: morning birdsong on the sunlit porch
clips.setting: The next morning: the sunlit wooden porch of the ancestral house.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Biến cố tưởng chừng đẩy gia đình xuống vực thẳm ấy lại kéo người cha lầm lỗi trở về cội nguồn, giữ trọn đạo hiếu làm con.
beats: @OngQuan stands with clasped hands before his father's clean stone grave in the green field.
@OngQuan stands with clasped hands bowing solemnly before Cụ Xá's newly refurbished stone grave surrounded by lush green rice paddies swaying in the morning breeze.
Camera cranes gently upward over the sunlit rice paddies surrounding the peaceful grave.
clips.sfx: wind through green rice fields, peaceful birdsong
clips.setting: Morning: Cụ Xá's newly restored stone grave among green rice paddies.

scenes.title: Món Nợ Được Hoàn Trả & Mâm Cơm Đoàn Tụ Nơi Quê Nội
scenes.time_label: Những ngày cuối năm ấm áp tại quê nội (13:00–14:00)
scenes.location: Sunlit porch of the three-bay ancestral house and the peaceful brick shrine under the green jackfruit tree.
scenes.axis: Warm family gathering on the sunlit wooden porch overlooking the clean brick courtyard and the ancient jackfruit tree at the gate.
scenes.props: Laptop and university readmission letter on the porch wooden table, steaming wooden tray of traditional Vietnamese family dishes, small white porcelain wine cup, burning incense at the jackfruit shrine.
scenes.setting: Late in the year, cool bright days: the sunlit porch with a wooden table, the clean brick courtyard and the small brick shrine under the jackfruit tree.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ở hiền gặp lành, cuối năm ấy công an triệt phá thành công ổ lừa đảo trên mạng và thu hồi phần lớn tiền cho Bình.
beats: @Binh sits at the wooden porch table with an open laptop.
On a bright year-end morning, @Binh reads an official notice on his laptop (screen text not readable) that the online scam ring has been caught and his money recovered.
@Binh's eyes light up with relief as he looks up from the laptop.
clips.sfx: cool year-end wind on the porch, a relieved exhale

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trả dứt được món nợ đè nặng trên vai, Bình được nhà trường nhận quay lại học năm cuối, mở ra cánh cửa cuộc đời mới.
beats: @Binh picks up a stamped university readmission letter beside his laptop.
@Binh lifts the letter in both hands (text not readable), smiling brightly with gratitude after months of darkness.
@Binh holds the letter close with a grateful, radiant smile.
clips.sfx: paper rustling in his hands, warm sunny courtyard ambience

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Những ngày cuối năm tiết trời se lạnh, cả gia đình lại quây quần ấm cúng bên mâm cơm đoàn viên nơi hiên nhà ngói quê nội.
beats: @Binh closes his laptop as @BaPhuong brings a steaming wooden meal tray to the porch table.
@Binh closes his laptop as @BaPhuong carries a steaming wooden tray of traditional dishes out onto the porch; @OngQuan, @BaPhuong, and @Binh gather warmly around the family meal.
@OngQuan, @BaPhuong, and @Binh sit together around the steaming family meal.
clips.sfx: bowls and chopsticks clinking, warm wordless family murmurs

clips.speaker: @OngQuan
clips.line: Đời người ai chẳng có lúc lầm đường lạc lối hả con, quan trọng nhất là biết quay đầu và sống trọn chữ hiếu với tổ tiên.
beats: @OngQuan pours a small porcelain cup of rice wine at the porch table opposite @Binh.
At the family meal table, @OngQuan pours a small cup of clear rice wine and sets it before @Binh, looking at his son with stern yet deeply loving eyes.
@Binh bows his head respectfully receiving his father's words while @BaPhuong smiles warmly.
clips.sfx: rice wine poured into a small china cup

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Buổi chiều muộn, Bình bước ra thắp ba nén nhang thơm nơi miếu gốc mít, thầm cảm ơn biến cố đã giúp gia đình mình tỉnh ngộ.
beats: @Binh walks across the swept brick courtyard toward the ancient jackfruit tree at the gate.

After the afternoon meal, @Binh walks across the clean brick courtyard to the ancient jackfruit tree by the gate and respectfully plants three fragrant burning incense sticks into the small brick shrine.
@Binh bows with clasped hands before the small brick shrine as three incense sticks glow.
clips.sfx: unhurried footsteps on swept bricks, incense crackling softly

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ngôi nhà từng bị cả làng gọi là nhà ma đầy khiếp đảm, nay đã thực sự trở thành chốn dương thịnh âm an bình yên.
beats: @Binh turns from the jackfruit shrine and walks back across the courtyard toward the porch.

From the small shrine beneath the jackfruit tree, the camera cranes slowly upward revealing the clean three-bay tiled house and courtyard where @Binh joins @OngQuan and @BaPhuong on the warm-lit porch.
High crane view of @Binh joining @OngQuan and @BaPhuong on the glowing porch under twilight.
clips.sfx: calm evening wind through the green jackfruit tree, warm porch ambience
clips.setting: Twilight at year's end: the clean brick courtyard, the small shrine under the jackfruit tree and the warm-lit porch.

scenes.title: Đêm Trăng Thanh Tịnh — Dương Thịnh Âm An & Lời Nhắn Cõi Âm
scenes.time_label: 22:00 Đêm trăng rằm thanh tịnh nơi quê nội (14:00–15:00)
scenes.location: Tranquil full-moonlit courtyard, glowing brick shrine under the ancient jackfruit tree, and warm-lit ancestral worship hall nestled among Northern Vietnamese rice fields.
scenes.axis: Serene moonlit progression from the glowing incense at the jackfruit shrine across the peaceful courtyard into the warm ancestral altar hall and up to the moonlit sky.
scenes.props: Three glowing red incense sticks in the brick shrine under the jackfruit tree, warm yellow altar lamps inside the three-bay house, silver full moon over rice paddies.
scenes.setting: Full-moon night, calm and peaceful: the moonlit courtyard, the glowing brick shrine under the ancient jackfruit tree and the warm-lit ancestral hall.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Quý vị thân mến, trên đời này có những nỗi tủi phận của người đã khuất mà đôi khi người đang sống vô tình lãng quên mất.
beats: Moonlit view of the ancient jackfruit tree and the small brick shrine by the gate.
Under a tranquil full moon, the camera glides slowly toward the shrine where three freshly lit incense sticks glow bright red in the night.
Close view of the three glowing red incense tips curling white smoke into the moonlight.
clips.sfx: crickets on a moonlit night, a soft breeze over the glowing incense

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sợi dây duy nhất có thể hóa giải mọi oán hờn giữa hai cõi âm dương, chính là chữ Hiếu và lòng thành kính từ tâm can.
beats: In the moonlit courtyard beside the porch, @VongCuXa's serene translucent figure stands watching.

Silver moonlight filters through the jackfruit leaves onto the clean brick courtyard; beside the porch pillar, the gentle translucent figure of @VongCuXa smiles at peace and dissolves into ascending light motes.
@VongCuXa smiles peacefully and dissolves into soft silver light motes rising into the night.
clips.sfx: wind chimes chiming softly as the grandfather turns into rising specks of light

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dù đi đâu về đâu, giàu sang hay nghèo khó, mỗi người con đất Việt xin đừng bao giờ để lạnh khói hương nơi bàn thờ tổ.
beats: Camera glides through the open wooden doorway into the warm-lit ancestral main hall.
The camera glides from the moonlit porch into the warm main worship hall where @Binh, @OngQuan, and @BaPhuong stand with clasped hands bowing reverently before the fragrant mahogany ancestral altar.
@OngQuan, @BaPhuong, and @Binh bow together before the glowing mahogany altar.
clips.sfx: soft hush of the warm altar room, faint incense crackle

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Bởi thứ mà ông bà tổ tiên đã khuất mong mỏi nhất, chỉ là tấm lòng tưởng nhớ hướng về cội nguồn của con cháu.
beats: @OngBay walks along the moonlit village lane past the open iron gate under the jackfruit tree.
Outside the open iron gate under the silver full moon, @OngBay walks leisurely along the village lane, smiling and nodding toward the warm-lit ancestral house before continuing on his way.
@OngBay smiles warmly looking into the bright courtyard, then walks on down the quiet lane.
clips.sfx: unhurried footsteps on the moonlit village lane, bamboo leaves rustling

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Khép lại câu chuyện Căn Nhà Âm Dương đêm nay, cầu mong mỗi mái nhà Việt Nam luôn giữ trọn được hơi ấm nghĩa tình muôn đời.
clips.camera: 24mm stabilized aerial drone slow ascending pull-back
beats: Wide view of the glowing three-bay ancestral house and courtyard under the full moon.

Wide aerial drone shot ascending slowly under the full moon: the three-bay tiled house where @Binh, @OngQuan, and @BaPhuong stand on the porch glows like a warm lantern amid vast Northern rice fields.
High aerial pull-back revealing the warm-lit house nestled peacefully among moonlit rice paddies.
clips.sfx: a gentle bamboo-flute melody blending with wind over the moonlit rice fields

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đồng hồ đã điểm sang canh ba, chúc quý vị ngủ ngon và hãy thử lắng nghe tiếng gió đêm đang thì thầm ngoài hiên nhà mình.
beats: Close framing on the three glowing red incense tips in the brick shrine under the jackfruit tree.
The incense tips brighten gently in the night breeze while, in the soft-focus background, @Binh quietly closes the wooden doors of the house.
The red incense tips glow softly in the moonlight as the wooden door clicks shut.
clips.sfx: a wooden door closing softly with a click, night wind through the jackfruit leaves
